WITH event_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    SUM(spent) / CAST(SUM(amount) AS REAL) as spend_ratio
  FROM budget
  WHERE spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
avg_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT 
  er.link_to_event as event_id,
  er.spend_ratio,
  er.spend_ratio / ar.avg_ratio as relative_ratio
FROM event_ratios er
CROSS JOIN avg_ratio ar
ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
